definitions.explanation: The collective term for items used for sleeping, including futons, blankets, pillows, sheets, and mattresses.

examples.japanese: {寝具|しんぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{寝具|しんぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to buy new bedding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{良質|りょうしつ}→良質：13949_ryoushitsu⟧な{寝具|しんぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{睡眠|すいみん}→睡眠：03359_suimin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that using quality bedding improves the quality of sleep.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{寝|しん} (sleep) + ⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ (tool, equipment).

USAGE:
{寝具|しんぐ} is a general category term that encompasses all sleeping-related items. It is used in shopping, hotel, and household contexts. More specific terms include:
- ⟦{布団|ふとん}→布団：01720_futon⟧: futon (mattress and/or comforter)
- ⟦{枕|まくら}→枕：03898_makura⟧: pillow
- ⟦シーツ→シーツ：04499_shiitsu⟧: sheets
- ⟦{毛布|もうふ}→毛布：03630_moufu⟧: blanket

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寝具|しんぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to arrange the bedding
- {寝具|しんぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{干|ほ}す→干す：00115_hosu⟧: to air out bedding
- {寝具|しんぐ}⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧: bedding manufacturer
- {寝具|しんぐ}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: bedding section (of a store)
